//how: Workflow JSON references __CRED__:<alias>; deploy.py resolves alias -> name -> real id via GET /api/v1/credentials.
//why-so-few: n8n holds no third-party credentials beyond the two below. Staff notification goes through Core API's /internal/notify/*, so 10DLC, opt-out and consent enforcement live in one place and cannot be bypassed. Adding a Twilio node here would reintroduce that bypass.
